1.ClickText: Hang freshly harvested flowers in a cool, airy place for a few days to turn them into dried flowers. It's a simple pleasure enjoyed by botanists. Used either as an ornament or a bookmark, these little objects add a touch of aroma to the mundane everyday life.

Floral compendia, pharmacological titles, guides on wild fruit consumption...A botanist's bookshelves are a treasure trove of books. However, they are not always neat and organized. Whenever Solise is engrossed in her research, she displaces and slots them everywhere. After all, what matters is that she scribbles down her fleeting thoughts.

Blurb blurb… blurb…The aroma of herbs flows from the crucible. Solise is making a concoction. Mustard jumping beans, red pearl fruits, twin persimmons… you can tell it's a special formula from just the aroma. But it's so fragrant... is it really a medicine?

2.ClickText: Every new Tainted arriving at the Island of the Banished erects a tablet in the wild, where they bury an item that represents their personal history. It signifies them letting go of their past. No such object can be found, however, under Baden's tablet.

A standard sword in the Lightbearer Empire's army, which Baden lost in the battlefield when he died. After becoming a Graveborn, he recovered the weapon which symbolizes his past. He still keeps it even though he has never used it.

The trees grow from rock crevices on the Island of the Banished, their misshapen and distorted form shaped by the harsh environment. Even so, they remain resilient and continue to flourish on this remote isle.

3.ClickText: Despite being strict adherent to the Temple's precepts, Belinda has retained some of her particular taste in food that she has developed while living in the Augustin family. One of her favorite drinks is the fruit tree she makes from Alluring Dew and Nyamnyam Honey; as for the rich and sweet fruit punch "Summer Love", she would take it in moderation.

The most prominent item in Belinda's room is this large colored portrait of the goddess Dura. Whenever she feels lost, the sight of the portrait will lead her to the answer. She believes the goddess is always smiling and gazing at her.

Belinda often sits at this desk of the Temple, burying her head in tomes studying the secrets of the Divine Light. But just like any maiden who reads voraciously, she also enjoys reclining on the comfortable chaise lounge, browsing the travelogues and poetry of Esperia.

4.ClickText: An old map lies on the desk. Its dog-eared edges and yellow hue indicate it has been used for years. Several locations are marked closely on the map. They are where Estrilda had marched with her army, and where Thane's old friend had been seen.

The butler of Rayne Manor well-known for his meticulousness. The clock is an essential item in the butler's room. Silent and precise, its hand creeps slowly on the dial––just like the butler, always calm and fastidious.

Here you'll find different swords: broad wooden swords, standard swords, single-handed swords... After losing his arm, Thane lost his will to live for a while. As he regained his former self, he tried many different types of swords, but he ultimately decided the Lotus Blade was the only sword for him.

5.ClickText: This is a robe often worn by Maetria while disguised as a scholar. Its Wilder-inspired look works well as a camouflage for her hidden identity as an Obsidian Finch. Being a Wilder scholar allows her to effortlessly reach out to those she thinks are valuable to her cause, and convey secret information about the Elemental Strife to them. After all, any intelligence received from a scholar carries significant weight.

Maetria's bookshelf is full of historical records about Esperia, among them the history of the Obsidian Finches. Maetria will never see the price paid by her tribe for fighting the Elemental Strife as a matter of course, and this harrowing past, despite having been recorded in writing, has never "existed" in the history of this planet. Each time she reads her scrolls of history, she becomes even more determined to restore the glory of the Obsidian Finches. Her resolve for this mission to revive her tribe has never wavered.

Occasionally, Maetria lounges in the chair before the coffee table... No, she does not have the leisure to do so! To her, everything on this planet is accompanied by destruction and rebirth, but the Obsidian Finches should not be a forgotten sacrifice. The world is oblivious and therefore has shown no gratitude to this small but great faction that once saved it from doom. Now that the elemental imbalance descends once again, the revival of the Obsidian Finches is no longer a distant hope. There is no way Maetria will let this opportunity turn into ashes.

6.ClickText: Athalia finally saw the redeeming, shimmering qualities in the weak mortals, and is now willing to respond to their prayers. Bearing a sharp and bright sword, she still walks the endless path of a punisher of sinners.

For Athalia, Dura is a wise mentor and a compassionate mother. She often stands before the goddess' figure, strengthening her belief through longing and confusion. She is devoted to cleansing the world of its filth and ridding Dura's Divine Light of any shadow.

An old weapon Athalia once used to punish countless mortals bewitched by the Hypogeans. She saw judgment and punishment as her mission, and dispensed her justice without mercy. That's because in her opinion, forgiving a blasphemer would be letting Dura down.

7.ClickText: Every time Safiya looks into the mirror, she thinks about her tortuous journey to the throne: from being a despised usurper, to a schemer in cahoots with foreign tribes that appropriated their power to solidify her position as queen… Once, she too was mired in self-doubt. But the mirror has dispelled all her inner shadows, revealing that her past is engulfed by her burning ambition, and what remains of her is the all-conquering Sphinx Queen!

The throne is the ultimate symbol of power and the object of Safiya's endless pursuit. The sense of dominance felt from power drives her to indulge herself in games of desire and deceit, for which she willingly surrenders her soul. When sitting on the opulent throne, she is reminded of her resolve to give everything up in exchange for the supreme seat of power.

Since ascending to the throne, Safiya has never slept in peace. Even during the briefest rest, she will not let her guard down. After coming into contact with the forbidden magic of the Void Realm, she always sees in her dreams figures and shadows that both terrify and enchant her. They seem to be manifestations of power which she finds irresistible. She is well-aware of all the threats around her, and it is only by fully mastering the magical force of the Void Realm that she can fortify her position of power.

8.ClickText: At the depths of the dream is a bottomless abyss, with flames that claw all surrounding consciousness into it. Awaiting these souls is an eternal, endless fall with no escape.
In dream worlds constructed by Ezizh, all logic and rules are rent and spliced together in a twisted form, making all that is aberrant appear sensible.
Entwined above the dream realm are eyes made up of endless voids. Greedily, they gaze into everyone's heart, prying into their deepest fears.

9.ClickText: This is where Lyca and her friends savor their afternoon tea every day before she becomes a commander. Since then, it has been a place where she takes care of her paperwork. She has given up many opportunities of gathering with her friends in the pursuit of becoming an excellent commander. Even late at night, she can often be seen toiling away at her desk.

This is where Lyca can totally forget about her worldly responsibilities and relax herself. Under a clear night sky, a snow-white doe transformed from the Astral Soul lies by the bed to accompany her in sleep.

Lyca and her younger brother Lorsan were inseparable, until they had the world's hopes and responsibilities thrusted onto their shoulders. Since then, they have been mostly apart from one another. Even so, this portrait always reminds Lyca of all the warm memories they once shared.

10.ClickText: After stepping out of the puppet workshop, the fuming spirits calmed down and left Shemira's body. They have had their revenge, so they no longer corrode Shemira's will and now reside peacefully in the Cursed Soulchain.

A portrait painted by Daimon. In it, he snuggles up to his mom and dad. Daimon's painting skills might not be accomplished, but Shemira has always cherished the portrait and hung it in a conspicuous spot. It represents the wish she and Daimon both share together.

Formerly a tailor, Shemira possesses a pair of skillful hands. Besides Daimon's favorite Stitchy, she also made many other adorable puppets for Daimon. This big teddy bear is about to be completed, and Daimon will soon have a new buddy.
